high_level_description: This image is a social media post from the Instagram account "iamamyjackson," which was posted 10 hours prior to the screenshot being taken. Below the illustration, the text "He is risen" is written, accompanied by a heart emoji. Illustration: The central focus of the image is an outline drawing of Jesus Christ.
